Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
When both hands are intact, HMG range increases by <color=#F74848>1</color>, and the number of bullets increases by <color=#F74848>1</color>. At the start of the action, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=2017500>[Fury]</buf>, to the maximum of <color=#F74848>2</color> stacks.

200001.name: CEC 1

201709.name: Suppressive Fire
201709.describe: Uses HMG to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.3x</color> DMG. Can activate <buf ID=2017072>[Firepower Unleashed]</buf>. When <color=#F74848>2</color> stacks of <buf ID=2017500>[Fury]</buf> are consumed, this attack cannot be dodged.

201703.name: Fiery Agression
201703.describe: Obtains <color=#F74848>2</color>AP, can continue to move <color=#F74848>3</color> tiles. Can attack after moving

201704.name: Wild Storm

Can activate <buf ID=2017072>[Firepower Unleashed]</buf>. When <color=#F74848>2</color> stacks of <buf ID=2017500>[Fury]</buf> are consumed, the critical hit rate of this attack increased by <color=#F74848>50%</color>.

300307.name: Exemplary

201707.name: Pinpoint Firepower
201707.SpecificEffects: When engaging in combat via <buf ID=900002>[Link attack]</buf>, if any part of the enemy is destroyed, gains <buf ID=900125>[Pinpoint Firepower]</buf>, up to <color=#F74848>2</color> stacks.

Can activate <buf ID=2017072>[Firepower Unleashed]</buf>. When <color=#F74848>2</color> stacks of <buf ID=2017500>[Fury]</buf> are consumed, the critical hit rate and critical damage of this attack increased by <color=#F74848>30%</color>.

200021.name: CEC 3

200022.name: Power Innovation 2

200033.name: Adaptive Warfare 1
200033.SpecificEffects: At the end of the action, if an Active Attack was not initiated this turn, an extra <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles can be moved.

200034.name: Perfect Position 2

201741.name: Ultimate Firepower 1

200043.name: Adaptive Warfare 2
200043.SpecificEffects:
If not moved before an Active Attack, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn. Unable to move before attacking.

201745.name: Ultimate Firepower 3
201745.SpecificEffects: When activating <buf ID=2017072>[Firepower Unleashed]</buf> and destroys a target, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat.

201746.name: Ultimate Firepower 4
201746.SpecificEffects: When activating <buf ID=2017072>[Firepower Unleashed]</buf>, for each <color=#F74848>1</color> AP consumed, DMG dealt is increased by <color=#F74848>7.5%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>45%</color>.
